messages:
Maria D: heads-up — I'm about to roll an RBAC change that tightens the backup-uploader service account. removing legacy s3:PutObject on `backups-legacy` bucket. could cause restores of older snapshots to fail. tagging @eng-sre :warning:
Ashok R: what failures are you expecting? any repro yet?
Maria D: saw one failed restore in staging: `AccessDenied` on decrypt step. logs attached below. not widespread yet.
Maria D: ```
2024-06-12T14:02:03Z restore-service ERROR AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::111111:role/backup-uploader is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-1234
CausedBy: missing grant for ciphertext encrypted with tenant CMK
```
Phil L: if snapshots were uploaded SSE-KMS with tenant CMK, the uploader needs a kms:Decrypt grant (or the restore path must assume a role that has it). grants can be time-limited too — check ListGrants.
Sarah O: we should also make sure KMS CloudTrail events are enabled for the CMKs in question and object-store access logs are ingested so we can pivot quickly.
Ken B: proposal: revert RBAC change for `backup-uploader` for 1 hour, then roll with a canary that keeps old perms for snapshots < 30d. that buys time to fix grants mapping.
Maria D: ok can do rollback. opening incident and PR now. dropping the minimal IAM snippet i plan to revert to:
Maria D: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject","kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::backups-legacy/*","arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-1234"]
    }
  ]
}
```
Ashok R: also double-check the key policy on the tenant CMKs — if they use a strict key policy we may need to create an explicit Grant for the uploader's principal.
Phil L: FYI grants created by console/SDK are visible via `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key>` — watch for grant btwn uploader role and the CMK.
encops-bot: Incident INC-20240612-452 created by Maria D — severity P2, assigned to eng-sre.
Sarah O: I'll turn on KMS event forwarding to splunk for the affected key ids and add alert for kms:Decrypt AccessDenied errors.
Ken B: runbook step: 1) rollback RBAC 2) create grant for uploader -> CMK (if key policy permits) 3) re-run canary restore 4) rotate to least-priv over 7 days. I'll draft the runbook section.
Maria D: PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/infra/iam/+/2345 — reverting policy + adding canary gating test.  starting rollback now.
Ashok R: after rollback, let's run `aws s3 cp` + restore flow against tenant-42 snapshot in staging. i'll validate decrypt path.
Phil L: adding note: if tenant CMKs deny grants, fallback is: use a transient decrypt proxy role that has decrypt rights and performs restore ephemeral creds. that requires audit + strong tracing.
Maria D: thanks all. will update thread when canary passes. :thumbsup:
Ken B: ping me when canary results in case we need a coordinated key-policy change across tenants.
Maria D: closing after successful canary. keeping audit logs for 90d as requested.
